purpose: Check whether prior copper futures close return improves future A-share excess return prediction beyond known prior A-share excess return.

features.copper: CU2609 close(T)/close(previous stock exchange session)-1; missing means exclude, never shift dates

target: stock raw close(T+3)/open(T+2)-1 minus CSI300 close(T+3)/open(T+2)-1; Buy T+2 open, sell T+3 close to respect A-share T+1.

models.augmented: OLS intercept+stock prior excess+copper prior close return

fit: per issuer chronological first 60 percent train / remaining 40 percent test; numpy lstsq no tuning; require >=28 observations 15 train 8 test
eval: paired test MSE: 1-MSE(augmented)/MSE(baseline), per issuer and equal issuer mean; no portfolio profitability claim
predefined_result: DESCRIPTIVE_SUPPORT_ONLY if both issuer test improvements >0; else NOT_SUPPORTED_BY_THIS_DEVELOPMENT_SAMPLE; INSUFFICIENT if coverage not reached
limitations: Historical outcomes already happened; chronological holdout not truly unseen.
Official historical source publication time unverified: trading at T+2 is conservative but not source-time certified.
Price-only, no verified lots, fees, fills, dividends, limit-up constraints.
Already researched historical windows mean not genuine clean OOS.
Never change sign/date/contract/model based on results.
